# MTGCheap

> MTGCheap is an AI and Machine Learning budget card swap engine and deck optimizer for Magic: The Gathering and Commander (EDH).

## Overview
MTGCheap helps Magic: The Gathering players find budget alternatives to expensive tournament and Commander staples. By leveraging 384-dimensional dense semantic vector embeddings and Scryfall functional oracle tags, MTGCheap identifies contextually accurate, lower-cost card replacements while preserving mechanical synergy and color identity rules.

## Core Features
- **Swap Engine**: Instant vector-based card replacement tool (`https://www.mtgcheap.com`)
- **Commander Deck Budgetizer**: Paste a Moxfield or Archidekt deck URL and specify a target budget to automatically replace expensive staples (`https://www.mtgcheap.com/deck-budgetizer`)
- **Strategy & Analysis Articles**: Deep dives into budget alternatives for top Commander staples (`https://www.mtgcheap.com/articles`)

## API & Endpoints
- Card Search API: `GET https://www.mtgcheap.com/api/cards/search?q={query}`
- Single Card Budget Swap API: `GET https://www.mtgcheap.com/api/budget-swap?target_card_name={card_name}&max_price={max_price}`
- Deck Budgetizer API: `POST https://www.mtgcheap.com/api/deck-budgetizer`
- Articles Index API: `GET https://www.mtgcheap.com/api/articles`
